## 3. Section 1 rulings, as applied

- **R1** — rungs k = 0, 1, 2, ... are generated down to and including the first k whose whole window [tau - W_k, tau] holds fewer than 34 = 2 x n_min collapsed trades. The windows are nested, so the count never rises with k and no finer rung can reach n_min on both halves: the cutoff drops no rung that could be valid. Rungs 0 and 1 are always generated (a2_ignition reads them). The 10 ms half-window floor and k_max = 40 still apply. Window count = the ladder's own n_recent + n_older (collapsed prints in [tau - round(W_k), tau]). *Why not the briefed rule:* briefed: stop at the first k where the segment-average rate predicts fewer than 17 collapsed trades per half-window (n_seg / 2^(k+1) < 17). Measured on Brief 1's Amendment 3 dev rungs before this config was written: it would not generate 33 of the 249 valid rungs (18 of 49 events; 58 on 25 if the cutoff rung is excluded), because trading bunches up before tau. The exact count generates 344 of 881 rungs, keeps all 249 valid rungs and cuts from_nothing 225 -> 12. `a2_ignition`: TRUE when rung 0 or rung 1 is from_nothing (older half empty, recent half non-empty): silence in the older half of the segment, trading in the recent half. A label only, no prediction attached. NULL when A2 is unavailable.
- **R2** — cell (year, clock segment of t, liveness L, window W, age octave); moments: every live name i at every clock minute t (hh:mm:00 ET) with tau_i < t, i live at t for L (age <= L; rest of session: any age), and no D1 crossing other than i's own within [t - W, t + W]; pooled across names and dates in the year. i's own crossing is allowed because a pair at age < W carries it in the same place (Brief 1's control rule). No draws: every minute is used, so no seed. Excess: observed pair log-ratio - the median log-ratio of the pair's baseline cell (finite log-ratios only). cells with fewer than 20 finite baseline moments are shown and labelled (baseline_thin) and not read.
- **R3** — a pair or baseline moment is valid only if [t - W, t + W] lies inside one clock segment -- premarket [04:00, open), regular [open + 60 s, close), after hours [close + 60 s, 20:00] -- and contains no cross minute ([open, open + 60 s), [close, close + 60 s)); open/close from the XNYS calendar (Amendment 3 A3.1). labelled window_crosses_segment and excluded on both sides; the share lost is reported per cell.
- **R4** — price tier on tau_price (the price of the tau print, the decision instant's price), edges [1.0, 3.0, 10.0] USD; jump_share bands ['<=0', '(0, 0.01]', '(0.01, 0.03]', '(0.03, 0.1]', '(0.1, 0.3]', '>0.3']; the detection-price decile facet retired.
- **R5** — open_adjacent_0930 is in no b2 artifact; Brief 1's t4_excursion.parquet keeps it as the as-run record.
- Brief 2's own task parameters sit in the config's `brief2` block (branch, brief, escalation, outputs, population, t1_excursion, t2_attention, t3_competition, t4_step_zero, verification); the one value the brief did not give is the gallery seed (20260925).

## 10. Column dictionary (section 5) — generated from the artifacts' schemas

Role: **pre-τ (attention)** = computed from prints at or before τ; **post-τ (excursion)** = from prints after τ; **facet** = a grouping variable fixed at or before τ; **competition** = another live name's trades around a crossing τ_j (T3, mechanism only). Amendment 3 names: `H_s` runs from the segment start (`H_0400_s` from 04:00); `a2_state`, `a2_anchor_ns`, `tau_anchor_segment`, `tau_in_auction_minute`, `win_lo_ns`, `win_mid_ns`; the A2 counts are nullable (NULL when A2 is unavailable). New in Brief 2: `a2_ignition`, `a2_rungs_generated`, `a2_cutoff_k`, `trades_per_min`, `dollars_per_min`, `shares_per_min`, `n_collapsed_seg_tau`.
